sources: 回滚清单.pdf · 第 1 页

q1.text: The release can move to Thursday. Who will confirm the rollback checklist?

interview.a1: 发布时间可以调整到周四。谁来确认回滚清单？\n\n决定：周四先向 10% 用户发布，周五复核错误率。
interview.me: 运维团队可以在周三前确认回滚清单。

q2.text: Lin will review error rates and login success on Friday.

interview.echo: Lin will review error rates and login success on Friday
interview.a2:
林会在周五复核错误率与登录成功率。

待办：运维周三前确认回滚清单。

variants.short: 决定：周四向 10% 用户发布。待办：周三确认回滚清单。
variants.example: 例如，回滚清单包括：停止扩量、恢复上一版本，并在确认后通知参会团队。

talk.name: 组会 · Mamba 论文报告

q1.text: 选择性状态空间和注意力比，长序列上优势在哪？

talk.a1: 注意力的计算随序列长度平方增长，Mamba 的选择性扫描是线性的。它让状态转移参数随输入变化，所以能按内容决定记住什么、忘掉什么，长序列上推理吞吐更高。
talk.me: 主要是线性时间扫描，加上参数随输入变化。

q2.text: 那在需要精确回看的任务上，它会不会吃亏？

talk.a2: 会有差距。固定大小的状态没法像 KV 缓存那样逐字回看，像关联回忆这类任务通常要混入少量注意力层来补。这也是我们下一步想验证的方向。

variants.short: 会。固定状态不能逐字回看，关联回忆类任务一般要混入少量注意力层。
variants.example: 比如让模型在长文里找出某个电话号码后面的名字：注意力可以直接回看原文，纯 Mamba 只能依赖压缩后的状态，越长越容易丢。
variants.translate: Yes, there is a gap. A fixed-size state can’t look back token by token the way a KV cache can, so recall-heavy tasks usually mix in a few attention layers. That’s what we want to test next.

meeting.name: 华东代理商 · 年度续约
sources: 年度报价表.xlsx · 阶梯价

q1.text: 如果单价再降 8 个点，你们能接受吗？

meeting.a1: 直接降 8 个点我们这边很难做。可以换个方式：年度采购量到 1.2 万台以上，我们给 5 个点，同时把账期从 60 天放宽到 90 天，你们的现金压力也小一些。
meeting.me: 8 个点很难，我们可以按量做阶梯价。

q2.text: 账期我们更看重，能不能只放账期，单价降 6 个点？

meeting.a2: 可以往这个方向谈。单价降 6 个点的前提是保底量不低于去年；90 天账期需要我们财务确认，我今天会后给你书面答复。

variants.short: 可以谈：6 个点以保底量不低于去年为前提，90 天账期会后书面确认。
variants.example: 比如按去年 1.1 万台保底：达到就降 6 个点，账期 90 天；不到保底量就回到 5 个点和 60 天。
variants.translate: We can work towards that. Six points requires a minimum volume no lower than last year; the 90-day term needs sign-off from our finance team, and I’ll confirm in writing after today’s meeting.

class.name: 操作系统 · 第 9 讲
sources: 第9讲-虚拟内存.pdf · 第 23 页

q1.text: TLB 未命中的时候，硬件和操作系统分别做什么？

class.a1: 先由硬件的页表遍历器按多级页表查找；页表项有效，就把映射填回 TLB 再重试访问。只有页表项无效时才触发缺页异常，由操作系统把页调入内存并更新页表。
class.me: 硬件先查页表，查不到才缺页。

q2.text: 那进程切换的时候，TLB 怎么处理？

class.a2: 两种做法：切换时整体刷新 TLB，或者用 ASID 给每个进程的表项打标签。用 ASID 时旧表项不会被新进程误用，也不需要全部清空，切换开销更小。

variants.short: 要么切换时刷新 TLB，要么用 ASID 区分进程，后者不用清空。
variants.example: 比如进程 A 和 B 都用虚拟地址 0x4000：有 ASID 时两条表项可以同时留在 TLB 里，各自带着自己的标签，切回 A 时直接命中。
variants.translate: Either flush the TLB on every switch, or tag each entry with an ASID. With ASIDs, stale entries can’t be used by the new process and nothing has to be flushed, so switches are cheaper.

talk.name: Lab meeting · Mamba

q1.text: Compared with attention, where do selective state spaces win on long sequences?

talk.a1: Attention grows quadratically with sequence length; Mamba’s selective scan is linear. Because its state-transition parameters depend on the input, it decides what to keep and what to forget by content — which gives higher inference throughput on long sequences.
talk.me: Mostly the linear-time scan, plus input-dependent parameters.

q2.text: Doesn’t it lose out on tasks that need exact recall?

talk.a2: There is a gap. A fixed-size state can’t look back token by token like a KV cache, so recall-heavy tasks usually mix in a few attention layers. That’s exactly what we plan to test next.

variants.short: Yes — a fixed state can’t look back exactly, so recall tasks usually add a few attention layers.
variants.example: Ask for the name next to a phone number buried in a long document: attention can look straight back at the text, while pure Mamba relies on a compressed state that degrades with length.
variants.translate: 会有差距。固定大小的状态没法像 KV 缓存那样逐字回看，关联回忆这类任务通常要混入少量注意力层来补。

meeting.name: Distributor · annual renewal

q1.text: Could you take another 8% off the unit price?

meeting.a1: A flat 8% is hard for us. Here’s another way: at 12,000 units a year we can do 5%, and extend payment terms from 60 to 90 days, which also eases your cash flow.
meeting.me: Eight points is tough — we can tier it by volume.

q2.text: Terms matter more to us. What about 90 days and 6% off?

meeting.a2: We can work towards that. Six percent assumes a minimum volume no lower than last year’s; the 90-day term needs our finance team’s sign-off, and I’ll confirm in writing after today’s meeting.

variants.short: Possible: 6% with last year’s volume as the floor; 90 days confirmed in writing after the call.
variants.example: With last year’s 11,000 units as the floor: hit it and you get 6% off on 90-day terms; fall short and it’s back to 5% on 60 days.
variants.translate: 可以往这个方向谈。单价降 6 个点的前提是保底量不低于去年；90 天账期需要我们财务确认，我今天会后给你书面答复。

class.name: Operating systems · lecture 9

q1.text: On a TLB miss, what does the hardware do, and what does the OS do?

class.a1: First the hardware page-table walker looks up the multi-level page table; if the entry is valid, it refills the TLB and retries the access. Only an invalid entry raises a page fault, and then the OS brings the page into memory and updates the table.
class.me: Hardware walks the page table first; only a miss there faults.

q2.text: And what happens to the TLB on a context switch?

class.a2: Two options: flush the whole TLB on every switch, or tag each entry with an ASID. With ASIDs, stale entries can’t be used by the new process and nothing has to be flushed, so switches are cheaper.

variants.short: Flush it on every switch, or tag entries with ASIDs so nothing needs flushing.
variants.example: Processes A and B both use virtual address 0x4000: with ASIDs, both entries stay in the TLB under their own tags, and switching back to A hits immediately.
variants.translate: 两种做法：切换时整体刷新 TLB，或者用 ASID 给每个进程的表项打标签。用 ASID 时不需要全部清空，切换开销更小。
